# ENDURA

> ENDURA is a premium physical-and-digital streetwear brand from Bangalore, India.
> Every piece "exists twice": a physical Rare-tier garment paired with a redeemable
> digital artifact. Mythology-driven design, founding-cohort drops, capped units.

## About
- Brand: ENDURA
- Based in: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Category: Premium / luxury streetwear, physical and digital fashion
- Core idea: "We exist twice" — each garment is bound to a digital collectible (a Digital Artifact) held in The Vault.
- First drop: the Genesis collection — three Rare-tier tees, each tied to a faction and a digital artifact.

## Products (Genesis collection)
- Icarus Ascension — Rare-tier tee, faction "The Crownless Era", bound to the Crownless Shard artifact.
- Cosmic Bull — Rare-tier tee, faction "The Forged", bound to the Celestial Core artifact.
- Liminal Touch — Rare-tier tee, faction "The Hollow", bound to the Silence Codex artifact.

## Digital Artifacts / The Vault
- Digital Artifacts have rarity tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary.
- Buying across categories unlocks fragments that assemble into higher-tier (Epic/Legendary) artifacts.
- The Vault is where a buyer's digital collectibles are stored and redeemed.
